patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently constrained to a central maximum width, providing clear visual boundaries.
Prominent, large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body text and uppercase labels.
A high-contrast, limited color palette primarily uses a deep blue, black, and white, with gray for secondary text, conveying a serious and professional tone.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that scrolls up with the page content, while the transparent header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Product and service offerings are presented in clear grid layouts, each with an image, bold title, and brief description.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed video element with a dark overlay to ensure text readability, which scrolls naturally with the page content. The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining its initial transparent background and white text/logo throughout the scroll, without any transformation.
Content sections are structured using a grid system for displaying related items, such as product listings, ensuring consistent spacing and alignment.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with all elements and images featuring crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, providing comfortable padding between sections and within grid items, with an airy feel in the hero section.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its prominent use of a full-bleed, industrial video as the hero background, immediately establishing a serious, high-tech, and authoritative tone. This is combined with a very clean, almost stark, typography and a limited, high-contrast color palette, making the industrial imagery central to the brand identity.
